args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and prevent auto-dismissal
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider to separate error toasts from non-error toasts so that errors are announced with aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, remaining until dismissed.

Error toasts should be announced assertively and should not auto-dismiss after five seconds so users have time to read and dismiss them.
